t: You're looking at 15 Clerkenwell Close, a building in Islington completed in 2017 and designed by Amin Taha with structural engineers Webb Yates. Its stone façade is the thing to notice. It was controversial because it hadn't been fully detailed in the planning documents, and Islington Council called for demolition, but that was overturned on appeal. It won a RIBA National Award in 2018 and was shortlisted for the Stirling Prize in 2021. It uses large pre-cut stone blocks in an innovative multi-level structural system.
